name: {720p} (GLOBAL) [SPPV]
description: This patch covers all individual XBE files in the collection except Bionic Commando.<br>When applying this patch to an XBE, disable all but the relevant labeled patch options.<br>Global edits should be applied to all XBE files.<br><br>Once loaded simply hit back BACK and click on VIDEO and you can adjust the screen size. All the working games are either FULLSCREEN 4:3 720P or WIDESCREEN 16:9 720P.
author: SPPV, via Jay's Magic Patches
region: NTSC, NTSC-J, PAL
